decision_scope: The bounded FORWARD/FULL optional-field addition conformance gate passes after fixing and isolating genuine FORWARD removals. Family-isolated generation, benchmark_ready promotion, and three-seed evaluation were not performed in this step.

optional_field_removal_under_forward.diagnosis: The actual base-to-candidate diff.fieldRemoved() was never evaluated by evaluateForward.

required_field_removal_under_forward.diagnosis: The reversed diff surfaced the removal only as REQUIRED_FIELD_ADDED, so the result was breaking but attributed to the wrong rule.

gap_reproduction_before_fix.previous_test_coverage: No explicit FORWARD-only genuine-removal regression existed. The only genuine-removal regression used CompatibilityMode.BACKWARD.
gap_reproduction_before_fix.full_masking_assessment: A same-direction removal checked under FULL would have been caught by FULL's BACKWARD half even while the FORWARD half was incomplete. The optional-addition conformance matrix contained additions only, so it did not itself contain or mask a removal case.

fix.actual_removal_path: DefaultCompatibilityEngine computes diff(base,candidate) and passes it explicitly to DefaultRuleEngine.evaluateForward. evaluateForward places diff.fieldRemoved() in a removal-only SchemaDiff and calls the unchanged evaluateBackward path, which applies RuleId.FIELD_REMOVED and the selected policy-pack severity.
fix.required_removal_deduplication: Fields present in actual diff.fieldRemoved() are filtered out of reversedDiff.requiredAdded(), preventing a required removal from being mislabeled as REQUIRED_FIELD_ADDED.

compatibility_runs.per_variant_profile_mode: Each string, integer, boolean, and array variant has 45 SAFE open calls and 45 BREAKING closed calls in FORWARD, and the same split in FULL.
